items.title: Renew Athens-Clarke occupation tax certificate
items.description: Occupation tax certificates are valid for the calendar year; renewal is due on or before April 1 and later applications carry a 10% penalty.

items.title: Obtain and renew Atlanta Business Occupational Tax Certificate
items.authority: City of Atlanta Office of Revenue
items.description: Businesses operating in Atlanta hold an occupational tax certificate, renewed annually through the city's online portal; certificates expire December 31.

items.title: Renew Augusta occupation tax certificate
items.description: Businesses operating in Augusta pay the annual occupation tax and receive a business tax certificate; see the city's due and payable dates.

items.title: Renew Columbus occupation tax certificate
items.authority: Columbus Consolidated Government Occupation Tax Section
items.description: Renewal runs January 1 through April 1 with a signed return, SAVE and E-Verify affidavits; unpaid tax carries a 10% penalty and 1.5% monthly interest.

items.title: Renew Sandy Springs business license
items.authority: City of Sandy Springs Revenue Department
items.description: Licenses expire December 31; the city allows a 90-day grace period to March 31, after which a 10% penalty and 1.5% monthly interest apply.

items.title: Renew Savannah business tax certificate
items.description: Business tax certificates expire December 31 and renew annually. The city's pages give March 1 for renewal (the 2026 form says March 31) and a January 31 payment date, so confirm on your renewal packet.
items.deadline: Certificates expire December 31; renewal packet date varies
